result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major layout problem where content is clipped at the bottom of the screen, a minor truncation issue in the horizontal restaurant list, and a minor accessibility concern with low-contrast promotional text.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the viewport. Only the food image and the '-20%' badge are visible, while the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine type are hidden behind the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom padding of the scrollable content area so the last card sits fully above the bottom navigation bar, or reduce the card height so all details remain visible.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list shows the truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' with the remainder cut off by the right screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a right margin to the last visible card and use text truncation (ellipsis) so the cut-off appears intentional, or ensure the full card is reachable by horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The promotional banner subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' appears in a very light color against the pale mint-green background, resulting in low readability.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or a slightly darker background shade to improve contrast and meet basic readability standards.
